Anthropic._comment: Live Claude remediation. Leave ApiKey empty here; supply it via the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable or dotnet user-secrets so it never lands in source control. With no key, remediation falls back to the deterministic StubRemediationService.

AzureAd._comment: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) SSO. Fill TenantId + ClientId to enable Entra sign-in; leave ClientId empty to keep the local stub sign-in. Put ClientSecret in user-secrets/env, never here. In the app registration, add a Web redirect URI of https://<host>/signin-oidc and a front-channel logout URL of https://<host>/signout-callback-oidc.
